questions.q: What does Greger call the number one cause of premature death?
a: A poor diet
A lack of sleep
Too much stress
A sedentary job
questions.why: The overview says the leading cause of early death is what we eat, which makes diet the central focus.

questions.q: What happened to advanced heart disease patients who switched to a plant-based diet?
a: Plaque buildup in their arteries began to dissolve
Their condition slowed but did not improve
They needed stronger drugs to manage symptoms
Their heart function declined more quickly
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the disease did not merely slow down but reversed as arterial plaque started to clear.

questions.q: How many daily servings of fruit does Greger recommend, and which kind is essential?
a: Four servings, including one of berries
Three servings, including one of citrus
Five servings, including one of bananas
Two servings, including one of apples
questions.why: Lesson 2 recommends four servings of fruit a day, one of which should be berries for their antioxidants.

questions.q: How many daily servings of vegetables does Greger recommend?
a: Five, with two leafy greens and one cruciferous
Three, with two leafy greens and one root vegetable
Four, with one leafy green and two cruciferous
Six, with three leafy greens and two legumes
questions.why: Lesson 2 recommends five servings of vegetables, two leafy greens and one cruciferous vegetable.

questions.q: How much daily exercise does Greger recommend for a long, healthy life?
a: 90 minutes of moderate activity, or 40 minutes of vigorous activity
30 minutes of moderate activity, or 15 minutes of vigorous activity
60 minutes of moderate activity, or 50 minutes of vigorous activity
20 minutes of moderate activity, or 10 minutes of vigorous activity
questions.why: Lesson 3 recommends 90 moderate minutes or 40 vigorous minutes of activity daily.
